blocks.text: Cianne Dominguez’s name has recently been making rounds on social media, with more netizens seemingly showing interest in her journey as a “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0” housemate. But before her stint in the reality show, Dominguez, born Tricia Anne D. Florendo, was already a familiar face to the Madlang People as she serves as one of the hosts of the noontime program “It’s Showtime.” Dominguez first rose to fame after she joined the show’s “Sexy Babe” segment in 2021.
